Name: Portraiture Emily portraits (includes cute seasonal outfits mod portraits)
Author: Lucky370
Description:
This is a portaiture mod for emily, that includes portraits for the seasonal outfits, slightly cuter aestatic mod.

Since someone was so kind to teach me modding, this mod now has a Content patcher version
To install just download the mod, unzip it and put the unzipped folder into your mod folder

DO BE WARNED the portraits are not fully centered so emily might move a little from left to right
Might be fixed in a future patch when i have time

Requires Content Patcher and the Seasonal Outfits slight cuter aestatics mod

If you only want the portaits then download the older file


If theres anything wrong let me know
This is my first time modding so bare with me 




Mods you need:

https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450 (seasonal outfits slightly cuter)
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915

https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999 (portraiture)
